National Apprenticeship Training Scheme is one of the flagship programmes of Government of India for
Skilling Indian Youth in Trade disciplines. The National Apprenticeship Training Scheme under the
provisions oftheApprentices Act, 1961 amended in 1973; offers Graduate, Diploma students and Vocational
certificate holders; a practical, hands-on On-the-Job-Training (oJT) based skilling opportunities with
duration ranging from 6 months to l year.
2.
Accordingly, Dr. A.PJ. Abdul Kalam Computer Centre, Panjab University, Chandigarh invite applications
for three (03) posts of Apprentices for Apprenticeship Training for a periodof 12 months (session
2024-25). Applications should be submitted with complete details on NATS PORTAL using URL
(https://nats.education.gov.in)
